summary: DoubleVerify Holdings filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) on October 20, 2026, supplementing its September 29, 2026 definitive proxy tied to its previously disclosed August 6, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with Neptune BidCo US Inc. (parent of The Nielsen Company) and Merger Sub Wallace. Under the cash merger, Merger Sub absorbs DoubleVerify, which survives as a wholly owned Nielsen subsidiary. The filing amends proxy disclosures and urges stockholders to vote at the Special Meeting; no price, premium, or vote date appears in the excerpt. Watch the special-meeting vote and any litigation-driven supplemental disclosures as the arb catalyst.
